items.name: DMS Components
items.text: Endpoints connect DBs/lakes. Classic uses sized EC2 instances; DMS Serverless auto-scales. Tasks define table mappings & rules.

items.name: CDC Log Prereqs
items.text: CDC reads source logs: Oracle redo/supplemental, SQL Server MS-CDC/Replication, MySQL binlog ROW, and PostgreSQL logical replication.

items.name: Operations & Tune
items.tag: AWS DMS, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon Redshift
items.text: Run in-VPC (SGs/VPN/DX); verify rows with data validation. Watch CDCLatencySource/Target in CloudWatch; Redshift uses S3 COPY.

items: DMS moves data only — use DMS Schema Conversion or SCT for schemas and stored procedures.
CDC not capturing changes usually points to missing source log prereqs (binlog ROW, supplemental, logical).
Zero-ETL (-> Redshift) beats DMS for supported sources; DMS is not for files (DataSync) or SaaS (AppFlow).
S3 target writes immutable change files, not mutable tables — a downstream MERGE job (e.g. Iceberg) is required.
